CheckTitle: Recovery Services Vault uses Private Link
Description: Verify that Private Link is configured.

Code.Other:
1. Note: Azure Backup requires Private Endpoints to be configured before any backup items are protected in the vault. If the vault already contains protected items, create a new vault and migrate items.
2. Enable system-assigned managed identity on the Recovery Services Vault and grant it required network and Private DNS Zone Contributor roles.
3. Create a Private Endpoint targeting the vault (sub-resource 'AzureBackup'): az network private-endpoint create --name <pe-name> -g <resource-group> --vnet-name <vnet-name> --subnet <subnet-name> --private-connection-resource-id <vault-id> --group-ids AzureBackup --connection-name <connection-name>
4. Approve the Private Endpoint connection: az network private-endpoint-connection approve --id <connection-id> --description 'Approved'
5. Configure Private DNS Zone integration (privatelink.<region>.backup.windowsazure.com)
6. Disable public network access: az backup vault update --name <vault-name> -g <resource-group> --public-network-access Disable

Recommendation.Text: Review and implement the recommended configuration for Recovery Services Vault Uses Private Link.
